row.category: Vertical SaaS (Healthcare, Education, Real Estate, Construction, Field Service)
row.evidence: Booqable's pricing page lists Single Sign-On only on the Custom plan (starts at $349), and neither its help centre nor its API reference documents SCIM; team accounts are invited and deactivated manually.
row.notes: Unchanged from June: no SCIM at any tier (none by absence). Prices unchanged: Start $29, Grow $69, Scale $149 per month billed yearly ($35/$87/$187 monthly), flat per business with 1, 6 and 11 users; Custom plan starts at $349 and is the only plan with Single Sign-On (SAML, generic IdP setup). API access starts on Grow, so the REST API is above the Start team plan (api_tax). The API's Employees resource lists, updates (including active/inactive and permissions) and invites team members; team accounts cannot be deleted, and deactivated users stop counting toward seats.
